desc: Prove/verify the greedy: process reconstruction tree bottom-up; at each node, we have multisets of unmatched A's and B's in its subtree; match min(|A|,|B|) pairs at this node's weight, pass the surplus upward.
Handle edge cases: A_i or B_j may repeat (sample 1 has repeated values), K up to N, weights up to 1e9 so use 64-bit (Python int fine); ensure O((N+M) log N) overall.
Implement solve(): read input, build DSU-based Kruskal reconstruction tree (arrays for children, weights, parent).
Count A and B multiplicities per vertex.
Iterative post-order traversal from root (last created node, index 2N-2 zero-based) computing (a,b) per node; accumulate answer.
Test against samples and random small cases vs brute force (itertools permutations + Floyd/Dijkstra minimax).
